what_was_run: canonical/tools/repeated_change_one_example_measure_v1.py, one demonstration, leave-one-out over every drawn file, on the 15 pull requests and 89 files of canonical/verification/REPEATED_CHANGE_ONE_EXAMPLE_20261112_V1.json, the files fetched again from their named commits and each checked against the sha256 the record holds (15 pull requests, 89 files, all as recorded)
coverage_is: the developers' own non-import changes that the organ made, over all the non-import changes they made in the drawn files
order: the ceiling is the organ's own repeat_tried with every try kept; the coverage is a share of its own ceiling, not of an outside idea
what_the_change_is: A rule is refused where the file uses code a way the examples did not show. Where the file already uses the new code that same way, at a place the change leaves alone, that use is shown -- by the file. Nothing is assumed: a name put in place of a name does not license the use on its own, because a name can be renamed because its signature changed (test_a_use_the_examples_did_not_show_is_shown_by_the_file_itself_v1).
limits: 8 kinds of change, 2 pull requests each: a claim about one kind has n=2 and is not a rate.
Python only, and only changes that repeat literally enough for one demonstration to fit them.
The witness reads one file. A use shown by another file of the same project is not read; that is the next widening and is unmeasured.
